spec.description: At-a-glance health of the selected database: status, traffic, and resource usage.

spec.title: Rolled-back transactions
spec.description: Share of transactions that were rolled back rather than committed.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT max((roll - roll_lag) / ((roll - roll_lag) + (comm - comm_lag))::numeric) * 100 AS tx_rollback_rate
  FROM (
        SELECT(data->>'xact_rollback')::int8 AS roll, 
              lag((data->>'xact_rollback')::int8) OVER w AS roll_lag,
              (data->>'xact_commit')::int8 AS comm, 
              lag((data->>'xact_commit')::int8) OVER w AS comm_lag
          FROM db_stats
         WHERE $__timeFilter(time)
           AND dbname = '$dbname'
        WINDOW w AS (ORDER BY time)
     ) x
 WHERE comm > comm_lag OR roll > roll_lag

spec.title: WAL size
spec.description: Total size of the write-ahead log folder.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  (data->>'wal_size_b')::float8 AS wal_size
FROM
  wal_size
WHERE
  $__timeFilter(time) 
  AND dbname = '$dbname'
ORDER BY time DESC
LIMIT 1

spec.title: Active queries
spec.description: Number of queries currently running.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT (data->>'active')::int AS active_cnt
FROM backends
WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND dbname = '$dbname'
ORDER BY time DESC
LIMIT 1

spec.title: Queries / sec
spec.description: Average number of queries executed per second.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT avg( (c - c_lag) / extract(epoch FROM time - time_lag) ) AS qps
  FROM (
        SELECT (data->>'calls')::int8 AS c, 
               lag((data->>'calls')::int8) OVER w AS c_lag,
               time, 
               lag(time) OVER w AS time_lag
          FROM stat_statements_calls
         WHERE dbname = '$dbname' AND $__timeFilter(time)
        WINDOW w AS (order by time)        
       ) x
 WHERE c >= c_lag AND time > time_lag

spec.title: Average query time
spec.description: Average time taken to run a query.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT avg(CASE WHEN c = c_lag THEN 0 ELSE (tt - tt_lag)::numeric / (c - c_lag) END) AS avg_query_runtime
  FROM (
        SELECT (data->>'total_time')::float8 AS tt, 
               lag((data->>'total_time')::float8) OVER w AS tt_lag,
               (data->>'calls')::int8 AS c, 
               lag((data->>'calls')::int8) OVER w AS c_lag
          FROM stat_statements_calls
         WHERE dbname = '$dbname' AND $__timeFilter(time)
        WINDOW W AS (ORDER BY time)
       ) x
 WHERE c >= c_lag AND tt >= tt_lag
 ORDER by 1 desc
 LIMIT 1

spec.title: Uptime
spec.description: Time since the database server last restarted.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT (data->>'postmaster_uptime_s')::int AS uptime
FROM wal
WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND dbname = '$dbname'
ORDER BY time DESC
LIMIT 1

spec.title: WAL archiving
spec.description: Whether transaction-log archiving is healthy, failing, or turned off.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT (data->>'is_failing_int')::int AS is_failing
FROM archiver
WHERE $__timeFilter(time)
  AND dbname = '$dbname'
ORDER BY time DESC
LIMIT 1

spec.title: Table structure changes
spec.description: Number of table, column, or function definition changes in the selected range.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT count(*)
FROM table_changes
WHERE $__timeFilter(time)
  AND dbname = '$dbname'

spec.title: Cache hit rate
spec.description: Share of reads served from memory instead of disk. Aim for 90% or higher.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT ((hit - hit_lag) / ((hit - hit_lag) + (read - read_lag))::numeric) * 100 AS cache_hit_ratio
  FROM (
        SELECT (data->>'blks_hit')::int8 AS hit, 
               lag((data->>'blks_hit')::int8) OVER w AS hit_lag,
               (data->>'blks_read')::int8 AS read, 
               lag((data->>'blks_read')::int8) OVER w AS read_lag
          FROM db_stats
         WHERE dbname = '$dbname' AND $__timeFilter(time)
        WINDOW w AS (ORDER BY time)
       ) x
 WHERE hit > hit_lag OR read > read_lag
 ORDER by 1

spec.title: Configuration changes
spec.description: Number of server setting changes in the selected range.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT count(*) AS changes_cnt
FROM configuration_changes
WHERE $__timeFilter(time)
  AND dbname = '$dbname'

spec.title: Free disk space
spec.description: Free space left on the disk holding the data directory.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT (data->>'free')::int8 AS free_space
  FROM psutil_disk
 WHERE dbname = '$dbname' AND $__timeFilter(time)
   AND tag_data->>'dir_or_tablespace' = 'data_directory'
 ORDER BY 1 desc
 LIMIT 1

spec.title: Database size
spec.description: Current size of the selected database.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT (data->>'size_b')::int8 AS size
FROM db_size
WHERE $__timeFilter(time)
  AND dbname = '$dbname'
ORDER BY time DESC
LIMIT 1

spec.title: Requested checkpoints
spec.description: Checkpoints triggered on demand instead of on schedule. Frequent ones suggest server tuning is needed.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT coalesce(sum(req - req_lag), 0) AS requested_cnt
  FROM (
        SELECT (data->>'checkpoints_req')::int as req,
               lag((data->>'checkpoints_req')::int) OVER(ORDER BY time) AS req_lag
          FROM bgwriter
         WHERE $__timeFilter(time)
           AND dbname = '$dbname'
       ) x
 WHERE req > req_lag

spec.title: Table bloat
spec.description: Estimated space that could be reclaimed by compacting tables.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  (data->>'approx_table_bloat_b')::int8 AS bloat
FROM
  table_bloat_approx_summary_sql
WHERE
  $__timeFilter(time)
  AND dbname = '$dbname'
ORDER BY 1 DESC
LIMIT 1

spec.title: Instance role
spec.description: Whether this server accepts writes (Primary) or is read-only (Replica).

spec.rawSql:
SELECT (data->>'in_recovery_int')::int
FROM wal
WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND dbname = '$dbname'
ORDER BY time DESC
LIMIT 1

spec.title: Unused indexes
spec.description: Invalid or duplicate indexes that can safely be dropped. They slow down writes without helping reads.

spec.rawSql:
WITH q_invalid AS (
  select count(*) as cnt
  from recommendations
  where
  time = (
    select max(time) from recommendations 
    where $__timeFilter(time) AND dbname = '$dbname' AND 
      tag_data->>'reco_topic' = 'drop_index' AND tag_data->>'issue_type' = 'invalid'
  )
  AND dbname = '$dbname' AND tag_data->>'reco_topic' = 'drop_index' AND tag_data->>'issue_type' = 'invalid'
)
SELECT
  sum((data->>'duplicate_count')::int8) + (select cnt from q_invalid)::int8
FROM
  recommendations
WHERE
  time = (
    select max(time) from recommendations
    where $__timeFilter(time) AND dbname = '$dbname' AND 
      tag_data->>'reco_topic' = 'drop_index' AND tag_data->>'issue_type' = 'duplicate'
  )
  AND dbname = '$dbname' AND tag_data->>'reco_topic' = 'drop_index' AND tag_data->>'issue_type' = 'duplicate'

spec.title: Autovacuum disabled
spec.description: Places where autovacuum is turned off, server-wide or per table. This causes stale statistics and bloat.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT 0 as time,
       sum(count) AS issues_count
FROM (
      SELECT count
        FROM (
              SELECT CASE WHEN (data->>'value')::float8 = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS count
                FROM settings_num
               WHERE dbname = '$dbname'
                 AND tag_data->>'name' = 'autovacuum'
                 AND time > now() - '1d'::interval
               ORDER BY time DESC
               LIMIT 1
              ) AS s
 
      UNION ALL

      SELECT count(*)
        FROM table_stats
       WHERE dbname = '$dbname'
         AND time = (SELECT max(time) FROM table_stats WHERE dbname = '$dbname')
         AND (data->>'no_autovacuum')::int = 1
 ) x;

spec.title: Longest query time
spec.description: Duration of the slowest query in the selected range.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT max((data->>'longest_query_seconds')::numeric)
  FROM backends
 WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND dbname = '$dbname'

spec.title: Idle open transactions
spec.description: Open transactions sitting idle. They hold locks and block cleanup.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT max((data->>'idleintransaction')::int) AS idle_in_tx
  FROM backends
 WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND dbname = '$dbname'

spec.title: Blocked sessions
spec.description: Queries waiting on locks held by other sessions.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT max((data->>'waiting')::int) AS waiting_cnt
FROM backends
WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND dbname = '$dbname'

spec.title: Longest autovacuum run
spec.description: Duration of the longest running autovacuum. Long runs can signal workload or tuning problems.

spec.title: WAL write rate
spec.description: Average write-ahead log bytes written per second.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT avg((wal - wal_lag) / (etime - lag_etime)) AS wal_rate
  FROM (
        SELECT (data->>'xlog_location_b')::int8 AS wal, 
               lag((data->>'xlog_location_b')::int8) OVER w AS wal_lag,
               extract(epoch from time) AS etime,
               lag(extract(epoch from time)) OVER w AS lag_etime,
               time
          FROM wal
         WHERE dbname = '$dbname' AND $__timeFilter(time)
        WINDOW w AS (ORDER BY time)
       ) x
WHERE wal >= wal_lag AND etime > lag_etime

spec.title: Temp file write rate
spec.description: Average temporary-file bytes written per second. High values mean queries exceed work_mem.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT avg(CASE WHEN tb - tb_lag > 0 THEN (tb - tb_lag) / (etime - lag_etime) ELSE 0 END) AS temp_bytes_per_hour
  FROM (
        SELECT (data->>'temp_bytes')::int8 AS tb, lag((data->>'temp_bytes')::int8) OVER w AS tb_lag,
               (extract(epoch from time))::int8 AS etime,
               (lag(extract(epoch from time)) OVER w)::int8 AS lag_etime
          FROM db_stats
         WHERE dbname = '$dbname' AND $__timeFilter(time)
        WINDOW w AS (ORDER BY time)
       ) x
 WHERE tb >= tb_lag AND etime > lag_etime

spec.title: Large table scans / min
spec.description: Full scans per minute on tables larger than 100 MB. Frequent scans often mean a missing index.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT sum((scan - scan_lag) * 60 / extract(epoch FROM (time - time_lag))) AS scan_count
  FROM (
        SELECT time, 
               lag(time) OVER w AS time_lag,
               (data->>'seq_scan')::int8 AS scan, 
               lag((data->>'seq_scan')::int8) OVER w AS scan_lag
          FROM table_stats
         WHERE $__timeFilter(time)
           AND dbname = '$dbname'
           AND (data->>'table_size_b')::int8 > 100000000
        WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY tag_data->>'table_full_name' ORDER BY time)
       ) x
WHERE scan > scan_lag AND time > time_lag

spec.title: Inactive replication slots
spec.description: Unused replication slots. They pile up transaction logs and can eventually fill the disk.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT sum((data->>'non_active_int')::int) AS slot_count
  FROM replication_slots
 WHERE time = (SELECT max(time) FROM replication_slots WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND dbname = '$dbname')
   AND dbname = '$dbname'

spec.title: Backup duration
spec.description: How long a backup has been running. Shows nothing when no backup is active.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  max((data->>'backup_duration_s')::int8) AS backup_duration
FROM
  db_stats
WHERE
  $__timeFilter(time)
  and dbname = '$dbname'

spec.title: Oldest snapshot XID age
spec.description: Number of transactions (XIDs) since the oldest active snapshot, held by a backend or replication slot. High values prevent VACUUM from cleaning up dead tuples and increase bloat/wraparound risk.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT max(xmin) AS max_xmin
FROM (
    SELECT max((data->>'xmin_age_tx')::int8) AS xmin
      FROM replication_slots
     WHERE time = (SELECT max(time) 
                     FROM replication_slots
                    WHERE $__timeFilter(time)
                      AND dbname = '$dbname')
       AND dbname = '$dbname'  

    UNION ALL

    SELECT max((data->>'max_xmin_age_tx')::int8) AS xmin
      FROM backends
     WHERE time = (SELECT max(time)
                     FROM backends
                    WHERE $__timeFilter(time)
                      AND dbname = '$dbname')
       AND dbname = '$dbname'
) x

spec.title: PostgreSQL version
spec.description: The running PostgreSQL major version.

spec.rawSql:
select concat((data->>'value')::int8 / 10000, '.', ((data->>'value')::int8 % 10000) / 100) as server_version
from settings_num
where dbname = '$dbname' and tag_data->>'name' = 'server_version_num' and $__timeFilter(time)
order by time
desc limit 1;

spec.title: Connections used
spec.description: Share of the connection limit currently in use.

spec.rawSql:
WITH s(max_connections) AS (
  SELECT (data->>'value')::int
  FROM settings_num
  WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND dbname = '$dbname'
    AND tag_data->>'name' = 'max_connections'
  ORDER BY time DESC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT round(((b.data->>'numbackends')::float / s.max_connections) * 100) AS conn_used_pct, max_connections
FROM db_stats b, s
WHERE $__timeFilter(b.time) AND b.dbname = '$dbname'
ORDER BY b.time DESC
LIMIT 1

spec.title: Replication lag
spec.description: How far behind the furthest replica is, in bytes.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  max((data->>'replay_lag_b')::int8) AS replay_lag
FROM
  replication
WHERE
  $__timeFilter(time)
  AND dbname = '$dbname'

spec.title: Transaction freeze age
spec.description: Age since the oldest VACUUM FREEZE. Very high values risk transaction ID wraparound.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  max((data->>'tx_freeze_age')::int8) AS tx_freeze_age
FROM
  table_stats
WHERE
  $__timeFilter(time)
  and dbname = '$dbname'

spec.title: New connections
spec.description: Number of new sessions opened during the selected range.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT max((data->>'sessions')::int8) - min((data->>'sessions')::int8) AS established
  FROM db_stats 
 WHERE dbname = '$dbname' AND $__timeFilter(time) 
 ORDER BY 1

spec.title: Total index size
spec.description: Combined size of all indexes in the selected database.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT (data->>'indexes_size_b')::int8
FROM db_size
WHERE $__timeFilter(time)
  AND dbname = '$dbname'
ORDER BY time DESC
LIMIT 1

spec.title: Transactions / sec
spec.description: Average transactions committed and rolled back per second.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT avg(((roll - roll_lag) + (comm - comm_lag)) / extract(epoch FROM (time - time_lag))) AS tps
  FROM (
        SELECT time, 
               lag(time) OVER w AS time_lag,
               (data->>'xact_rollback')::int8 AS roll, 
               lag((data->>'xact_rollback')::int8) OVER w AS roll_lag,
               (data->>'xact_commit')::int8 AS comm, 
               lag((data->>'xact_commit')::int8) OVER w AS comm_lag
          FROM db_stats
         WHERE $__timeFilter(time)
           AND dbname = '$dbname'
        WINDOW w AS (ORDER BY time)
      ) x
WHERE (comm > comm_lag OR roll > roll_lag) AND time > time_lag

spec.title: Database growth
spec.description: Percent change in database size over the selected range.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT (last_value - first_value) / first_value::numeric * 100 AS size_diff_pct
  FROM (
      SELECT first_value((data->>'size_b')::int8) OVER w,
             last_value((data->>'size_b')::int8) OVER w
        FROM db_size
       WHERE dbname = '$dbname' and $__timeFilter(time)
      WINDOW w AS (
         ORDER BY time ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING
       )
) x
ORDER BY 1 DESC
LIMIT 1

spec.title: Database growth (size)
spec.description: Change in database size over the selected range.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT last_value - first_value AS size_diff
  FROM (
      SELECT first_value((data->>'size_b')::int8) OVER w,
             last_value((data->>'size_b')::int8) OVER w
        FROM db_size
       WHERE dbname = '$dbname' and $__timeFilter(time)
      WINDOW w AS (
         ORDER BY time ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING
       )
) x
ORDER BY 1 DESC
LIMIT 1

spec.title: Rows inserted / min
spec.description: Average rows inserted per minute.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT avg(((ins - ins_lag) * 60) / extract(epoch FROM time - time_lag)) AS ins_per_min
  FROM (
        SELECT (data->>'tup_inserted')::int8 AS ins, 
               lag((data->>'tup_inserted')::int8) OVER w AS ins_lag,
               time, 
               lag(time) OVER w AS time_lag
          FROM db_stats
         WHERE dbname = '$dbname' AND $__timeFilter(time)
        WINDOW w AS (ORDER BY time)
       ) AS x
 WHERE ins >= ins_lag AND time > time_lag

spec.title: Rows updated / min
spec.description: Average rows updated per minute.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT avg(((upd - upd_lag) * 60) / extract(epoch FROM time - time_lag)) AS upd_per_min
  FROM (
        SELECT (data->>'tup_updated')::int8 AS upd, 
               lag((data->>'tup_updated')::int8) OVER w AS upd_lag,
               time, 
               lag(time) OVER w AS time_lag
          FROM db_stats
         WHERE dbname = '$dbname' AND $__timeFilter(time)
        WINDOW w AS (ORDER BY time)
       ) AS x
 WHERE upd >= upd_lag AND time > time_lag

spec.title: Rows deleted / min
spec.description: Average rows deleted per minute.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT avg(((del - del_lag) * 60) / extract(epoch FROM time - time_lag)) AS del_per_min
  FROM (
        SELECT (data->>'tup_deleted')::int8 AS del, 
               lag((data->>'tup_deleted')::int8) OVER w AS del_lag,
               time, 
               lag(time) OVER w AS time_lag
          FROM db_stats
         WHERE dbname = '$dbname' AND $__timeFilter(time)
        WINDOW w AS (ORDER BY time)
       ) AS x
 WHERE del >= del_lag AND time > time_lag

spec.title: Peak connections
spec.description: Highest number of connections seen in the selected range.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT max((data->>'numbackends')) AS max_conn_count
  FROM db_stats 
 WHERE dbname = '$dbname' AND $__timeFilter(time) 
 ORDER BY 1

spec.label: Source Name

spec.query: SELECT DISTINCT dbname FROM admin.all_distinct_dbname_metrics ORDER BY 1;
spec.rawSql: SELECT DISTINCT dbname FROM admin.all_distinct_dbname_metrics ORDER BY 1;

spec.definition: SELECT DISTINCT dbname FROM admin.all_distinct_dbname_metrics ORDER BY 1;
